title: Item
description: A scene-level item: a placed instance of a component or component set with quantity, transform overrides, and per-instance properties.

id.description: Unique instance identifier for this item within its parent collection.

name.description: Optional display name override for this instance.

component.description: ID of the Component in the registry to instantiate. Mutually exclusive with 'componentSet'.

componentSet.description: ID of the ComponentSet in the registry to instantiate. Mutually exclusive with 'component'.

quantity.description: How many copies to spawn. When > 1, spawnOffset.position is applied cumulatively unless 'quantityTransform' is specified.

quantityTransform.description: Incremental transform applied between each copy when quantity > 1 (e.g. stack offset).

transform.description: Instance-level transform override, composed after the component's own transform.

spawnOffset.description: Instance-level spawn offset, overrides component/set-level spawnOffset.

properties.description: Per-instance property overrides merged on top of the component's property table.

tags.description: Additional tags for this instance only.

scripts.description: Additional script bindings for this instance only.

snapTo.description: Optional: automatically snap this item to a snap point on another object at spawn.

targetId.description: ID of the item or component to snap to.

targetSnapId.description: ID of the specific snap point on the target. Omit to use the first available.

sourceSnapId.description: ID of the snap point on this item to use for alignment.

enabled.description: When false, this item is defined but not spawned.

group.description: Logical group name for batch operations (select all, spawn all, destroy all).
